package.description: OpenRA modernizes the classic Command & Conquer real time strategy games.

en-US.description: OpenRA modernizes the classic Command & Conquer real time strategy games.
en-US.longDescription:
OpenRA is a project that recreates and modernizes the classic Command & Conquer real time strategy games.
We have developed a flexible open source game engine (the OpenRA engine) that provides a common platform for rebuilding and reimagining classic 2D and 2.5D RTS games (the OpenRA mods).
en-US.name: OpenRA
